steps.what: Perform clerical duties by hearing the request for scheduling exams or special procedures.
outputs: exam she was asked to schedule

steps.what: Open the diary and read which times are free.
Decide the time for those exams or special procedures.
inputs: exam she was asked to schedule

steps.what: File exam booking v1, keeping records of the exam and the time.
Confirm archiving of the computerized images in the imaging store.

tasks.design: She hears the request, opens the {CALENDAR} and reads which times are free, chooses one, and files exam booking v1 herself. She then opens the {OTHER} imaging store and confirms the computerized images are stored. Nothing is messaged to the patient, and no alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: The free time and the stored study are things she has to open and read.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new reads the diary or checks the study for her.
tasks.still_hard: A time she did not read, and a study she did not open, stay unbooked and unconfirmed.
tasks.human_edge: She can book only a time she read, and confirm only images she opened.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still reads the diary, files the booking, and checks the images.

reach.learn: The time is one she read in the diary, not a generated slot.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she still opens the diary, files the booking, and checks the images herself. A measurement aid for another imaging job does not schedule the exam or confirm the study.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.

The diary is the {CALENDAR} category. It already holds date, start, end, and exam type from whoever booked earlier, including her. She opens it and reads those fields herself. That reading is not a saving. A time the diary does not show is not treated as free.
She files exam booking v1 herself and checks, on that same step, that it names the exam and a time she read. No second version is sent. The patient is not messaged.

The computerized images come from the scan, which is another task and is not counted here. The imaging store is the {OTHER} category. She opens the study and looks. She does not copy it. A missing study is not marked stored.
No model schedules. No alert is raised. No listing replaces opening the diary.
unknowns: Whether the diary already shows the exam length she needs.
research_questions: Who else may move the booked time after she has filed it.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one exam she hears the request, reads the diary, chooses the time, files the booking, and checks the images, and none of those steps is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Watch students or other medical sonographers during the scan.
inputs: student or sonographer on the scan

steps.what: Decide which part of the scan to correct.
Supervise and train them by saying what to change.

tasks.design: She watches students or other medical sonographers during the scan, decides what to correct, and tells them. No note is filed and nothing is sent. No alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: The scan is something she has to watch before she can correct it.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new watches the scan or chooses the correction for her.
tasks.still_hard: A scan she did not watch stays uncorrected.
tasks.human_edge: She can correct only what she watched them do.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still watches the scan and trains them in the room.

reach.task: stand in on a training scan
reach.learn: The correction is one she spoke after watching, not a generated note.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she supervises and trains by watching the scan and saying what to change. A measurement aid does not watch the student.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
Students and other medical sonographers are in the department. She watches the scan, then tells them. The talk is inside the organisation. No version is filed, so it is not gated.
No model trains. No alert is raised. No listing replaces the watching.
unknowns: Whether a student who is only visiting, with no place in the department, is outside this task.
research_questions: Who else may correct the student after she has spoken.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one scan she watches the student, decides the correction, and says it, and none of those steps is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep supplies and order when short.

steps.what: Look in the cupboard to maintain stock and supplies.
Preparing supplies for the special examinations she will perform.
Decide whether ordering supplies is necessary.
Tell the stores colleague which supplies are short.

tasks.design: She looks in the cupboard, prepares the supplies for the special examinations, decides whether an order is necessary, and tells the stores colleague what is short. No order is sent outside the hospital, and no alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: The stock is something she has to see in the cupboard.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new sees the cupboard or prepares the supplies for her.
tasks.still_hard: A cupboard she did not look in stays unordered.
tasks.human_edge: She can order only the supplies she saw were short.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still sees the stock, prepares the supplies, and tells stores.

reach.learn: The supplies are the ones she saw in the cupboard.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she sees the stock, prepares the supplies, and tells stores what is short. A screen she would still have to open is not a saving.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
She sees the cupboard herself. No par level is stored, and she does not invent a quantity she did not see. No listing replaces that look.

The stores colleague is inside the organisation. When something is short she tells them. When the cupboard covers the examination she tells them nothing further is needed. No request version is filed, so the talk is not gated. She does not send an order to an outside supplier in this task.
unknowns: Whether a short item is ordered from an outside supplier on another task.
research_questions: Who else may ask stores for the same supplies after she has spoken.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one examination she looks in the cupboard, prepares the supplies, decides whether an order is necessary, and tells stores, and none of those steps is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Safety reports, consent, and abuse reports.

steps.what: Perform a look for safety, accident, invasive procedures, or symptoms of abuse or neglect.
inputs: event, procedure, or symptoms in front of her

steps.what: Decide the legal and ethical duties, including written consent or a report.
Preparing safety or accident reports, or the note reporting symptoms, as duty record v1.
Obtaining written consent from the patient on duty record v1.
outputs: duty record v1 with the patient signature

steps.what: File duty record v1 after the signature or the finished report.
inputs: duty record v1 with the patient signature

tasks.design: She notices the duty, decides whether it is written consent or a report, and writes duty record v1 herself. For consent she reads it to the patient and takes the signature on that same record, then files it. No second version is sent, and no alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: The event, the procedure, or the symptoms are something she has to notice herself.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new notices the duty or writes the record for her.
tasks.still_hard: A symptom she did not see stays unreported.
tasks.human_edge: She can write only what she noticed, and the patient signs only the record she wrote.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still notices the duty, writes the record, takes consent when that is the duty, and files it.

reach.learn: The note is what she wrote from what she saw.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: she notices the duty, writes the record, takes consent when that is the duty, and files it. A measurement aid does not make that judgement.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.

This performance is one duty: written consent for an invasive procedure. An accident report or a note reporting symptoms of abuse or neglect uses the same writing and the same file, and does not take a patient signature. One episode is one duty.

She writes duty record v1 herself. The draft step is not gated. The patient signs that same record in the room. She does not send a second version. Filing is inside the organisation. On the file step she checks that it states what she saw and that the signature is on it.
Reporting abuse in this task is the filed internal note. A notice to a body outside the hospital is not this task.
No model writes the record. No alert is raised. No listing replaces what she noticed.
unknowns: Whether abuse must also be notified outside the hospital on another task.
research_questions: Who else may change the filed duty record after she has filed it.

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On one invasive procedure she notices the duty, decides it is consent, writes the record, obtains the signature, and files it, and none of those steps is shorter, so the saving stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still schedules exams, trains sonographers, keeps supplies, and performs the legal duties. Nothing is handed off.
reach: A radiologic technologist learns an exam time is one she read in the diary, not a generated slot.
A registered nurse learns a consent note is one she wrote from what she saw.
skills_to_grow: Read the diary herself before booking an exam.
Correct a scan only after watching it.
See the cupboard before asking for supplies.
Write a consent or a report from what she saw.
role.ambitious_version: The same sonographer still schedules, trains, keeps supplies, and writes the legal records. Nothing is sent in her place.
